data.name: DUSTBLOOM
data.detailed_description:
You are part of the 15th expedition team sent to a barren, unforgiving red planet. Your mission is clear: survive the harsh environment, automate resource production, and terraform the dead world into a lush, green paradise. But there is a dark secret buried beneath the dust. The 14th team vanished without a trace. It is up to you—and your friends—to uncover their fate through hidden audio logs while fighting for your own survival.

🌍 Dynamic Terraforming (From T0 to T3) Experience a true sandbox transformation. You will start in a desolate red desert (T0) where survival is a constant struggle. By building machines and increasing your Colony Index, you will change the planet's atmosphere. Watch the sky turn blue, witness the first rain, and plant vast forests as you reach T3. Every machine you build physically alters the world around you.

🛠️ The Crawler: Your Ultimate Mobile Base You aren't stuck in one place. Construct, upgrade, and drive a massive mobile base across the planet. Build greenhouses on its deck, set up automated crafting stations inside, and park it wherever you need. Your base is your fortress, your factory, and your home.

⚔️ Survive the Nightly Sieges During the day, you build. At night, you fight. As darkness falls, relentless waves of skeleton hordes emerge from the dark valleys, attacking from three different directions. Craft powerful swords, bows, and deploy shock flares to hold the line. The more you progress, the harder they push back.

🏰 Dungeons, Bosses & Exploration The planet is massive, featuring 8 distinct biomes ranging from glowing caves to treacherous mountains. Hidden across the map are ancient sealed dungeons. Break the seals, avoid deadly spike traps, loot golden chests, and defeat terrifying bosses to claim rare artifacts. You might even stumble upon floating tracks high in the sky!

🤝 1-4 Player Co-op Experience DUSTBLOOM is built from the ground up for seamless multiplayer. Play solo or team up with up to 3 friends using Steam Online Co-op or standard LAN. Share your resources, assign roles (defender, builder, explorer), and experience the entire story and terraforming process together.

Key Features:

  • Deep Automation: Set up resource loops, manage energy, and upgrade your technology tier.

  • Weather Events: Survive dynamic environmental hazards, including deadly meteor showers.

  • Highly Optimized: Built on a custom engine architecture to ensure smooth gameplay even on low-end systems.

  • Story-Driven Exploration: Piece together the mystery of the doomed 14th team through scattered voice logs.

data.short_description: Team up with friends in this 1-4 player co-op survival game. Build a massive mobile base, automate your production, and terraform a dead red desert into a lush green world. Craft weapons to survive nightly skeleton attacks and uncover the dark mystery of the lost 14th team.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible integrated or dedicated graphics
  • DirectX: Version 8.0
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2048 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Highly optimized for low-end systems thanks to the custom Godot 4.6 architecture.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 570 or equivalent
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2048 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for the smoothest experience while playing co-op with friends.
